scope: Second reading of all 85 added expressions: original excerpt, page/segment, contextual English definition, Chinese meaning, adapted example/translation, register, and limitations. These are Phrase-schema entries, including receptive single words; this does not certify Word-card IPA/mnemonics or audio. Retained means a substantive second-pass judgment, not an automatic inheritance of reviewed_complete. Source-ambiguous paragraphs stay pending independently of lexical entries.
entries: News-attention sense is distinguished from manufacturing news; the community-project example and translation retain that sense.
Outcome/judgment ambiguity is explicitly acknowledged; example chooses a report's judgment without pretending to quote the incident.
Concessive transition and route example agree; no unsupported causal relation is added to the original transition.
Recorded images and uncountable usage are correct; security-footage example preserves the mass-noun construction.
Perfect passive is explained with has/have and the original that's contraction; example uses instructions made public.
Physical reverse movement is appropriate for the parking spot; figurative withdrawal is distinguished, not substituted.
Purpose/result alternatives are maintained without assigning intent to the student; lamp example clearly illustrates purpose.
Definition concerns applying brakes, not steering; note explicitly refuses to certify the quoted maneuvering claim.
Verbal suppress-expression meaning is clear; source motive remains attributed and the example preserves an argued risk.
The note distinguishes loose source extension from the system-default teaching example; source inference is not presented as a rule.
Opposition rather than travel fits the talk-show context; proposal example transfers the oppositional meaning without endorsing criticism.
Appearance-versus-certainty boundary is preserved; seemingly simple example is natural and translation does not assert actual simplicity.
Ongoing passive is correctly identified; survey example and Chinese translation preserve ongoing analysis rather than a completed conclusion.
Intransitive sudden-start meaning fits protests; argument example correctly uses broke out without an object.
Participial demand, not difficult adjective, is explained; statement example is natural and avoids adjudicating the claim.
Strong evaluative force is retained; note keeps the original felt-like attribution rather than certifying brutality.
Adverb describes manner; source viewpoint is distinguished from verification and the closure example is grammatical.
Feelings connected with a situation, not physically involved objects; strong-emotions example is natural and transferable.
Knower after to is distinguished from characteristic after for; support-team example matches the relevant sense.
Continuing harmful speech/conduct rather than substance abuse; official characterization is kept attributed, not adopted as fact.
Figurative exclusion is taught with standard has no place; suspect source It is no place is explicitly not copied as a model.
Final-year student sense fits graduation; not an older person or executive. Example and Chinese translation are consistent.
Filing is initiating a civil court action, not winning it; fictional example and note avoid implying an outcome.
Naming sense, not audio dubbing, fits Cornell Seven; quiet-corner example is natural and label is not treated as culpability.
Training-event sense fits attend; communication example distinguishes the repair-premises meaning without adding factual claims.
Reflective written assignments, not optical reflection; source self-repair is acknowledged and project example is natural.
Twenty-four seven and all-day/every-day meaning are correct; availability label does not reconstruct the incomplete PSA or verify live hours.
Podcast references rather than theatrical notes; links example transfers naturally without claiming the website was checked.
Advance notice of distressing material fits the next passage; example is natural and no uniform reaction is assumed.
Documents submitted to court, not court findings; article-quotes example and caution preserve this evidentiary distinction.
Official publicly accessible records are distinguished from journalism; note appropriately avoids a guarantee of unrestricted access.
Overstatement sense fits the narrator's explicit qualification of lawyer numbers; disaster example correctly illustrates rhetorical excess.
In this American context football is American football, not soccer. Correct Chinese gloss and teaching translation to 美式橄榄球队; preserve the nonliteral group-size warning.
Physical postal delivery fits plastic cards; replacement-card example correctly means already sent, not email or sea freight.
Emphatic lack of practical significance is kept as evaluation; promise example is natural and does not validate the insurance-card criticism.
Clarity of wording is not truth verification; source lawyer is a reporting channel and instructions example preserves explicitness.
Changed destination is correct for intended donations; message example naturally illustrates routing without issuing any transfer instruction.
Enabled action with anticipatory it is accurate; coordination example reflects feasibility, not guaranteed performance.
Collaborative arrangements fit episode support; source does not establish legal entity form or romantic relationships.
Commitment is supported, full-time/exclusive employment is not. Remove 专职 from the gloss and clarify that the source praises commitment, not employment status.
Scalar unexpected example is correctly distinguished from time; imagined refusal is not presented as an authenticated company quotation.
American college organizations, not biological sisters; campus-event example preserves plural agreement and contextual category.
Greek-letter organizational system, not life in Greece; campus guide example is accurate and source extension is explained.
Probable removal rather than physical dropping; mailing-list example preserves probability and source membership is not made into a universal rule.
Wristband is explicitly marked as contextual inference, while source band stays intact; guest example is an adapted illustration, not a reconstructed quote.
Shared membership rather than kinship; event-planning example is natural and does not imply every member's conduct.
Non- negates fraternity membership, not a family relation; source-specific label and open-event example retain that distinction.
Activity-related sports sense fits anything athletic; example uses athletic activities rather than body shape or fitness.
Prospective membership commitment is distinguished from full initiation and monetary pledging; campus example fits the source sense.
Nonspecific detail sense fits the disclaimer; vague about the starting time is natural and does not equate vagueness with falsehood.
Figurative target rather than movement; feedback example and not-directed source scope are both correctly preserved.
Typical/reflective meaning and the negative disclaimer span 194–195; complaint example does not turn a single case into all views.
Conversational get-passive and bodily action are explicit; fictional childhood example describes punishment without recommending it.
Uncooked, not unripe, is the intended contrast; voluntary salad example is clearly separated from source coercion.
Exercise verb and coercive passive are explicit; fictional recruits example illustrates grammar without providing a technique.
Declaring not proving sincerity, with elevated exaggeration; coffee example transfers humorous overstatement and source coercion stays explicit.
Peak metaphor and career example are sound; note explicitly warns that source praise is sarcastic and adjacent uncertainty remains.
Equal ranking rather than restraint; fifth-place example explains the compressed source ranking without verifying the percentage.
American auto means motor vehicle here, not automatic; category example and translation match the source comparison.
Source means supposedly less severe, not cheerful. Replace the stiff evaluation-report example with natural quoted disagreement; do not normalize this into a safety judgment.
Informal intensity is captured by a full-on argument; note prevents the source's contrast from implying other harm is acceptable.
Stacked sleeping arrangement is correct; room example is clear and the source's several fall scenarios are not joined into one event.
Small shallow surface water fits slip on; doorway example is natural, and possible suit is not established liability.
Narrating rather than recounting numbers fits experience; first-year-at-work example preserves past-event reporting.
Full status/development sense and product example work; original fully pledged repetition is preserved, not silently corrected.
Composition verb is correctly active, not was consisted of; presentation example avoids reproducing an abusive mixture recipe.
Passive make takes to, unlike active make someone crawl; compulsion and omitted source auxiliary are explicitly distinguished.
Physical sudden falling fits the source; fictional exhausted-person example does not diagnose a cause or substitute business failure.
Newspaper-article sense fits Cornell Sun; whole article example and recording-relative recently note are accurate.
American spirits sense fits contrast with beer cans; empty-bottle example does not infer who drank from them.
Very soon rather than precisely one second; explanation example is natural and no timestamp is inferred.
Rule/expectation rather than inability; hallway-box example is transferable and not represented as a complete legal statement.
whether on the road or in the chapter house
Alternative-setting construction and travel/home example are natural; source brotherhood metaphor is explicitly a separate coverage gap.
Expected role is captured by coordinator example; source fragment is completed by preceding context, not a verified performance claim.
Marking verb rather than postage noun or foot movement; ticket example and X-shaped-mark note are coherent.
Theme-based modifier is correct; teaching hyphen is appropriate and does not silently edit source or certify cultural authenticity.
Capable of + gerund expresses capacity; training example explains language without making a legal or clinical capacity determination.
Persistent supply/urging sense is taught through ply someone with; tea example avoids reproducing alleged substance administration.
Formal participation construction is correct; discussion example does not import consent into the source's explicit absence of consent.
Attempted hand movement toward a target is distinct from completed contact; folder example naturally preserves that action.
Anatomical euphemism rather than ownership; respectful terminology example teaches receptive meaning without added explicit detail.
Quick warding-off movement is correctly distinct from generic pushing; fly example illustrates action without replacing source resistance.
Sudden firm hold is accurate; rail example is natural and the note does not assign an unsupported rescue motive.
Informal genuine/credible sense matches the imagined message interpretation; verify-sender example maintains uncertainty rather than authentication.
Informal very-drunk sense fits a person's photo interpretation; fictional example does not substitute a measured alcohol level.
